text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Spadina Road, City Council approval of this report is required. This report identifies and rectifies conflicting stopping and standing prohibitions, and pay and display and maximum one-hour parking limit by-laws on both sides of Spadina Road, between Montclair Avenue and Strathearn Boulevard.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing maximum one-hour parking limit in effect from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m., Monday to Saturday, and at all times on Sunday, on the east side of Spadina Road, between Montclair Avenue and Thelma Avenue. 2. City Council amend the stopping prohibition in effect from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on the east side of Spadina Road, between a point opposite Russell Hill Drive and Eglinton Avenue West, to be in effect from Russell Hill Drive to Montclair Avenue, and Thelma Avenue to Eglinton Avenue West. 3.
